known_exposure: All datasets reused in prior exploratory campaigns; no external confirmation possible from new splits
randomization_unit: model-development split seed (four clusters/cycle), repeated randomized label acquisitions nested under split
budget: same exact unique acquired labels for SRS, stratification and PPS; zero-label proxy distinguished
baseline_rule: All methods see equal unlabeled features and frozen probabilities; true labels only for queried indices; true total risk only for scoring
commit_policy: Preregister each block before run, commit raw results and A–J before choosing following block; preserve failures
novelty: No 2/3 claimed: PPRM 2026, unbiased active learning Imberg 2020 and risk monitoring literature are existing rivals
